objective: Prepare a cybersecurity GRC case for a proposed regional delivery operator handling customer addresses, driver dispatch and supplier integrations. Assess operator identity access and dispatch service integrity; all systems and roles must be verified with the organization.

draft.title: Threat hypothesis: Password Policy Enforcement for Driver Dispatch
draft.content: To ensure the integrity of the dispatch service and verify all systems and roles, a specific Password Policy Enforcement system will be established. This system will manage the application of password rules and user education to prevent weak passwords and password reuse.

proposed_attributes.proposed_value: Drivers and dispatchers may choose weak passwords or reuse them across different systems, including personal and professional accounts.
Unauthorized access to the dispatch service and customer data, leading to data breaches and loss of trust.

draft.evidence_request: Password complexity rules and password reuse monitoring logs for the IAM system.
draft.verification_question: Can the Password Policy Enforcement system detect and prevent weak passwords and password reuse across different systems?
